div.head: Iudex 14
div.ab: Se hatheorta dema ne mæg he behealdan ðas domes riht, for ðan þe for ðæs yrres dimnesse he ne mæg geseon ðas rihtes beorhtnesse.
Iracundus iudex non potest attendere rectam iudicii satisfactionem: nam per furoris excecationem non perspicit rectitudinis claritatem.
The angry judge cannot focus on just judgements because due to the darkness of his wrath, he cannot see the brightness of justice.
Der zornige Richter, der kann nicht [im Auge] behalten Richtigkeit des Urtheilspruches, weil er wegen des Zornes Umdüsterung die Klarheit des Rechtes nicht zu ersehen vermag.
The angry judge cannot keep [in view] the rightness of the judgment, because through the darkening of anger he cannot see the brightness of what is right.
